slides.title: Say *what you did.*
slides.body: Specific beats vague. “I forgot your thing,” not “sorry for whatever.”

slides.title: Own it. *No “but.”*
slides.body: “I’m sorry, but…” cancels the sorry. Stop at sorry.

slides.title: Name *how it felt.*
slides.body: “That probably made you feel ignored.” Let them correct you.

slides.title: Ask *what would help.*
slides.body: Don’t guess the fix. Ask, then actually listen.

slides.title: Change *the thing.*
slides.body: The best apology is never having to make the same one twice.

slides.title: Save this *for the next “sorry.”*
slides.sub: Then send it to the one who still says “sorry you feel that way.”
